text:
Partly, yes. The JRC GFC2020 V4 map does not show the 2023 loss itself. It is a 2020 forest/non-forest reference map. It shows that the area affected by the 2023 loss was forest in 2020, and the agreement is full (1.0 of the event area).

The loss itself comes from Hansen/UMD, which mapped about 0.7 ha (1.2% of the 58.1 ha asset) of tree-cover loss in 2023. Hansen data through 2025 were observed, and together with the JRC agreement this corroborates the loss under the method used.

The MGAP 2021 map puts most of the affected area in planted forest (0.4 ha, Eucalyptus). The remainder is 0.3 ha outside mapped forest, and none is native forest. Hansen also shows a further 0.4 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha, which was not counted as an event.

This does not establish deforestation (cutting a plantation counts as loss), the cause, legality, responsibility, or any compliance finding.
